summary: Implementation plan for comprehensive mobile-first responsive optimization of Mini Makers across all viewports (320px to 1440px+). Fixes horizontal scrolling, adds a 900px hamburger navigation with right slide-in drawer, fluid clamp() typography and spacing, 2/3/4-column adaptive product grids, compact mobile wizard with iOS zoom prevention (16px/48px inputs), 56px floating action buttons with safe-area spacing, and touch-first tap targets without changing design aesthetics.
